note: Adapted from the English species-level description in Hill (1942); the original describes the alate and the soldier, and lists the worker only as a morphotype without describing it. OCR problems: the headline reads "Hamitermes (Hamit ernes) xylophcijgus Hill"; "Pairiph." is for Pamph.; "Pig." is for Fig.; "ochraceous huff" is for buff; "sth" is for 5th; "heighc" is for height. The type locality, Australian Capital Territory: Canberra, agrees with the checklist. Distribution and biology have not been translated into the morphology sections.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The alate is very similar to A. neogermanus and differs in being smaller, in the slightly darker postclypeus, the relatively larger fontanelle, the different shapes of the pronotum, mesonotum and metanotum, and in differences of venation. The soldier is most easily confused with that species and differs in the mandibles, the smaller labrum and the deeper head (see also A. modicus).

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Pronotum similar to that of A. neogermanus, but the sides more rounded and the posterior margin more deeply incised. Posterior parts of the mesonotum and metanotum distinctly narrowed, the incision of the posterior margin deeper and sharper than in that species. The radial vein of both wings nearly obsolete. Measurements: length with wings 13.25 mm, length without wings 7.25—7.40 mm, head length (to apex of labrum) 1.48 mm, head length (to clypeofrontal suture) 0.74 mm, head width 1.14 mm, greatest diameter of compound eye 0.29 mm, ocellus length 0.12 mm, pronotum length 0.55—0.59 mm, width 1.03 mm, fore wing length 11.25—12.00 mm, width 3.10—3.20 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head ochraceous yellowish brown, mandibles rust-coloured, antennae and legs straw-coloured. Head rather deep, posterior part broadly rounded, sides slightly contracted. Labrum longer than wide, anterior part broadly rounded. Mandibles slightly longer than half the head capsule, slender, with a blunt, backward-directed tooth at the distal two-fifths. Antennae 15-segmented; segment 3 usually the smallest, sometimes fused with segment 4; segment 4 about as long as segment 6; segment 5 shorter than segment 6. Measurements: total length 5.50 mm, head length (including mandibles) 2.00 mm, head length (to clypeofrontal suture) 1.14—1.18 mm, head length (to apex of labrum) 1.50 mm, head width 1.03 mm, pronotum length 0.37 mm, width 0.66 mm.
